description: This is a PHP class defining the 'jjwg_Areas' model, extending 'jjwg_Areas_sugar'. It manages geographic areas, including polygons and centroids, and provides methods for defining geometries, checking if points are within areas, and retrieving configurations. The class interacts with map settings and external map-related beans, indicating it is part of a geographic or mapping module within a larger software project.

classes.name: jjwg_Areas
classes.description: A class representing geographic areas with polygonal boundaries, centroid calculations, and spatial queries. Extends 'jjwg_Areas_sugar' and integrates mapping configurations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object and loads configuration if specified.

methods.name: configuration
methods.description: Loads map-related configurations and initializes 'jjwg_Maps' bean.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves the object by ID and defines the polygon, area, and centroid accordingly.

methods.name: define_polygon
methods.description: Parses the coordinate string to define the area polygon as an array of lng/lat/elv points.

methods.name: define_area_loc
methods.description: Defines the location of the area based on its centroid.

methods.name: define_centroid
methods.description: Calculates the centroid (geometric center) of the polygon.

methods.name: define_loc
methods.description: Defines a location point from a marker object or array, with validation and defaults.

methods.name: is_valid_lng
methods.description: Checks if a longitude value is within valid bounds (-180 to 180).

methods.name: is_valid_lat
methods.description: Checks if a latitude value is within valid bounds (-90 to 90).

methods.name: is_marker_in_area
methods.description: Tests whether a given marker falls within the area polygon.

methods.name: is_point_in_area
methods.description: Checks whether a specified lng/lat point is within the polygon boundary.

methods.name: point_in_polygon
methods.description: Implements point-in-polygon algorithm to determine if a point lies inside the polygon.

methods.name: point_on_vertex
methods.description: Checks if a given point matches any polygon vertex, indicating the point is on a vertex.

methods.name: point_string_to_coordinates
methods.description: Converts a coordinate string 'lng,lat,elv' into an array with 'x' and 'y' keys (lng, lat).
